items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I had to sing everything. I said, that's your number Earl and he said, I forgot it.

ctx.x: Yeah, they stand up and they just keep on. They don't ever stop applauding.

Yeah, that's lovely. You told me one funny thing about Earl (Hines) when you made that record session with him, when they recorded that live at Montreux. You said you were doing one of Earl's numbers and he didn't remember the number and you had to sing it to him.
